steps.s1Body: A call or a visit. We look at the floor plan, the handover date and how you will use the apartment.
steps.s2Body: A layout and a shortlist for every room, priced as one package.
steps.s3Body: You approve the pieces. Remotely, if you are abroad.
steps.s4Body: Everything arrives together, timed to your handover.
steps.s5Body: Assembled, placed and styled by our team.
steps.s6Body: You walk into a finished home.

services.stagingBody: For sellers and agents: furnished, styled and ready to show.
services.rentalBody: For owners who rent out. Durable and neutral for long-term tenants, guest-ready down to kitchenware and linen for holiday lets.
services.customBody: Individual design projects beyond the standard packages.

faq.q1: What is included in a package?
faq.a1: Furniture for every room of the apartment type, plus delivery and installation. The room-by-room list is on each package page.
faq.q2: I live abroad. Can I do this remotely?
faq.a2: Yes. Many buyers are not in Cyprus at handover. Concept, selection and approval happen online, and we install before you arrive.
faq.a3: Same Studio, 1+1 and 2+1 structure, chosen for the purpose: durable and neutral for long-term tenants, guest-ready down to kitchenware and linen for holiday lets.
faq.a4: Yes. All prices are in GBP and start from £10,000 for a Studio, £12,000 for a 1+1 and £14,000 for a 2+1.
